outside_body: This app works inside Telegram only. Open the bot and press “Open Googlagent”.
expired_body: Close this window and open the app from the bot again.
denied_body: Close this window and open the app from the bot again. If that does not help, contact the studio owner.
error_body: Could not reach the server. Please try again in a minute.
ready_body: Sign-in confirmed. The placement test will appear here: tell me about yourself by voice.
catalog_error: The catalog did not load. Please try again.
empty_branch: Skills of this branch will come later.
road_agent: The agent does it: the platform leads the work, you accept the result.
road_self: Do it yourself: the agent gives a prompt pack, you work on your side.
price_note: Prices come from the model catalog when the skill runs.
unlock_level: The agent road opens at level {level}. Doing it yourself is open from level 1.
